speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you have a history of gait and limb ataxia; to understand the underlying cause, can you describe exactly how your walking and coordination have been affected?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: The patient reports a "drunk" appearance when walking and specific clumsiness on the right side. Is your balance worse when you close your eyes, or does this happen only in the dark?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: PML (Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy) secondary to natalizumab therapy in a patient with Crohn's disease.
